headline: Poland Evacuates Airport Tower and Scrambles Jets After Missiles Hit Polish Territory
summary: Poland evacuated its Rzeszow Airport control tower and scrambled fighter aircraft after two Russian missiles and a drone landed in eastern Poland during a strike on Ukraine. Operations at the regional airport were temporarily suspended.
why: Military strikes landing within NATO member states risk direct military escalation and heighten geopolitical risk premiums for European markets.

impacts.name: Polish Zloty
impacts.why: Escalation risks on Polish borders exerted downward pressure on local currency sentiment.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Russian ordnance striking Polish territory created immediate geopolitical risk aversion across Eastern European asset classes.
